description:
Using the loaded 'usa.gdt' dataset, perform the following econometric analysis:

1. Create a new variable for quarterly GDP growth rate (percentage).
2. Run an OLS regression of GDP growth on inflation.
3. Diagnose serial correlation using the Durbin-Watson statistic.
4. Apply the Cochrane-Orcutt iterative AR(1) correction to the model.

Save your work in two files in '/home/ga/Documents/gretl_output/':
- 'cochrane_orcutt.inp': The complete Gretl script used.
- 'cochrane_orcutt_results.txt': A text file reporting the original OLS Durbin-Watson statistic, the estimated AR(1) coefficient (rho), and the corrected coefficient estimates (intercept and inflation slope).

metadata.data_source: Principles of Econometrics, 5th Edition (Hill, Griffiths, Lim)
